chunks: Nor will you worship what I worship
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Nor will you worship what I worship' in Surah Al-Kafirun?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the theological principle of *Tawhid* by distinguishing between the monotheistic worship of the Ahl al-Bayt and the polytheistic or idolatrous practices of the disbelievers, emphasizing that true worship requires both correct object and intention. It serves as a definitive boundary marker for the faithful, rejecting syncretism even when outward forms of ritual appear similar. This divergence is not merely ritualistic but rooted in the fundamental difference between divine guidance and human deviation.
